# Velair 1.9.1

This patch release fixes error messages in climate reference setpoint settings.

## 🛠️ Fixed

- Show readable Home Assistant errors instead of `[object Object]` when saving heating or cooling reference setpoints or reviewing target formats. If no useful error message is available, show a localized fallback. Thanks to @sankukace for reporting [#78](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/78).

## 🧭 Notes

- After updating through HACS, restart Home Assistant and refresh the browser or Companion app to load the corrected frontend.
- Translated guides remain synchronized with their English sources and await human linguistic review.
